resources.string: Delete every saved password from this device? Saved connections stay, and you will have to type the passwords again.
Saved unencrypted: debug build, and this device has no screen lock.
Delete the saved password for %1$s on %2$s?
Every saved password will be deleted from this device and its unlock keys destroyed. Saved connections stay.
An administrator password is deleted as soon as the server rejects it, and it is never used for anything other than the operation you authorized.
Not available on this device, which needs a strong fingerprint
Save passwords on this device and unlock them with a fingerprint.
No longer valid: the device fingerprints changed. Delete it, and save the password again if you still need it.
This device authenticator is weaker than a strong fingerprint, so a host administrator password is not offered here.
These reminders are set to not appear again on this device. Turn one off to bring it back.
Strong fingerprint, confirmed for every use
Screen lock, valid for five minutes after unlocking the device
The administrator password was not saved. Press Authorize again to continue without saving it.
Enter the administrator account and password.
Save the administrator password on this device
Saving an administrator password needs a strong fingerprint sensor, so it is unavailable on this device.
File operations are available through the privileged Helper. Ordinary terminal and Git operations are unavailable for this account.
The server certificate was not trusted, so no request was sent.
Trust applies only to this server address, port and certificate. Check its SHA-256 fingerprint before continuing.
Signed in, but the password was not saved.
Signed in, but the password was not saved: %1$s
Signed in. The password was saved unencrypted, because this is a debug build and the device has no screen lock.
This login belongs to a managed installation with no host record on this device. Add the host in the server centre.
%1$s is a managed host. Establish its SSH tunnel in the server centre, then sign in.
Enter the server address and account.
No usable fingerprint or screen lock was found, so a password cannot be saved on this device.
This device has no screen lock, so a password can only be stored unencrypted here. Debug builds allow that; release builds never do.
Enter the password to sign in.
Save the password on this device and unlock it with the fingerprint
Save the password on this device (debug build: stored unencrypted)
Saved password (debug build, not encrypted) · leave the field empty to sign in with it
Saved password · leave the field empty to sign in with the fingerprint
The saved password is no longer valid. Enter the password and save it again to replace it.
Saved password · leave the field empty to unlock it with the screen lock
The saved password cannot be unlocked on this device right now. Enter the password to sign in.
Server found. The preferred endpoint will be used.
Enter a host or HTTP(S) root address. Ports must be 1–65535. Do not include user information, query parameters, fragments or subpaths.
No RelaxKonOS login endpoint could be reached at this address.
Connect to your RelaxKonOS server. Your password is sent to this server for sign-in. Saving it on this device is optional.
SSH authentication failed. Check the SSH username, password or private key.
The login SSH tunnel could not be confirmed closed. Force stop the app in system settings before connecting again.
Enter SSH credentials or select a saved SSH connection.
SSH tunnel connection failed. Check the SSH host, credentials and remote Server address; for HTTPS, verify that its certificate is valid for 127.0.0.1.
Server address is on the SSH host, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5000. The local port is automatic. SSH and Server credentials are separate.
Enter an SSH host, username and port (1–65535). The remote HTTP(S) URL must use localhost or 127.0.0.1 at the root path, without user information, query or fragment.
Use a private key (paste PEM/OpenSSH text)
The saved SSH tunnel configuration is missing. Configure it again.
Connected, but SSH credentials could not be saved securely.
SSH tunnel and remote Server are reachable.
One saved password serves SSH and Server. Use the save option below; saving and unlocking each require one fingerprint confirmation. Password authentication only.
Use the Server username and password for SSH
Enter the Server password to use it for SSH.
I verified the fingerprint; trust and connect
Verify this fingerprint with the host administrator. If a previous fingerprint is shown, the host key has changed.
Pair this Android device with a Windows workstation that already has an enrolled owner device.
Pair with %1$s? The pairing code expires %2$s.
Confirm to use the Android owner-device key
This Android device is not paired with the selected server.
Paste a pairing code from an enrolled Windows device.
Paste the one-time pairing code created on the Windows 10 or 11 computer. The Android device keeps its private key locally and never sends the Windows password.
This pairing code is invalid, expired, or does not name an HTTP(S) server.
Could not scan this QR code. Try a clearer image or paste the pairing code.
No QR pairing code was found.
Saved password not supported on this device
SSH password not saved on this device
Remember the last successful administrator username and file picker locations on this device. Clearing affects the current account on this server and keeps saved passwords.
This device has no strong fingerprint sensor, so the saved password is protected by the screen lock and can be used for five minutes after you unlock the device.
The saved password can no longer be unlocked because the device fingerprints changed. It stays on this device until you delete it; sign in with the password and save it again to replace it.
Too many failed attempts. Try again later, or enter the password.
Fingerprint unlocking is locked. Unlock the device with its screen lock, then try again.
The saved password could not be verified. It stays on this device; enter the password and save it again to replace it.
Fingerprint unlocking is not available on this device right now. The saved password is not affected.
Confirm with your fingerprint to store the password for %1$s on this device.
Confirm with your fingerprint to store the administrator password on this device.
